dataset_filters.realm_filter: Exactly one core realm (Terrestrial, Freshwater, Marine) per publication; Not Applicable, All realms, multi-label realm combinations, and transition/subterranean realms are excluded
dataset_filters.driver_filter: At least one usable IPBES L1 driver label

panel_driver_composition.grain: UT x realm x distinct IPBES L1 driver
panel_driver_composition.fractional_weight_formula: w_i,d = 1 / k_i, where k_i is the number of distinct IPBES L1 drivers assigned to publication i; sum_d(w_i,d) = 1
panel_driver_composition.share_formula: share_d,r (%) = 100 * sum_i(w_i,d) / N_r, where N_r is the number of unique publications in realm r

panel_pollution_plastics_exploitation_tr.scope: Same direction/year/realm/driver-filtered publications as the driver-composition panel
panel_pollution_plastics_exploitation_tr.pollution_and_exploitation_attention_for: share_r,y (%) = 100 * sum_i(w_i,d) / N_r,y for d in {Pollution, Direct Exploitation and Resource Extraction}, same 1/k weighting as the driver-composition panel
panel_pollution_plastics_exploitation_tr.plastics_within_pollution_formula: share_r,y (%) = 100 * n_plastics_mention / n_pollution_and_text_available (unweighted document count, not fractional)
panel_pollution_plastics_exploitation_tr.plastics_mention_source: Precomputed at data-processing time (notebooks/data_processing/04_dataset.ipynb, via evidence_corpus_prep.DEFAULT_PLASTICS_PATTERN) from title + abstract text with a case-insensitive regex; persisted as the text_available/plastics_mention columns on dataset.parquet so this notebook never loads abstract text
panel_pollution_plastics_exploitation_tr.figure_smoothing: Solid lines are a 5-year centered rolling mean of the annual values; faint lines/points show the raw annual share
panel_pollution_plastics_exploitation_tr.exported_endpoint_values: Raw 2000 and 2025 annual share_pct values as quoted in the manuscript; no trend model is fitted

artifacts.csv/realm_article_counts.csv: Unique-publication counts per core realm after all dataset filters.
artifacts.csv/realm_exclusion_audit.csv: Counts of direction/year-filtered publications excluded at the realm-filtering step, by exclusion reason.
artifacts.csv/core_realm_driver_composition.csv: IPBES L1 driver x core-realm fractional composition (%) behind the manuscript figure.
artifacts.csv/driver_realm_summary.csv: Full driver x realm summary: prevalence and fractional share.
artifacts.csv/realm_trend_annual.csv: Annual pollution / plastics-within-pollution / direct-exploitation shares per core realm behind the supplementary figure.
artifacts.figures/l1_driver_composition_core_realm: Manuscript figure: IPBES L1 driver composition across the three core realms.
artifacts.figures/pollution_plastics_exploitation_: Supplementary figure: pollution, plastics-within-pollution, and direct-exploitation attention trends across core realms, 2000-2025.
